tasks.title: Identify every fitted component
tasks.detail: Record board labels, power ratings and connector names; resolve unknown parts before wiring.

tasks.title: Prepare tools and the test area
tasks.detail: Multimeter, insulated wiring, stable wheel support and an accessible motor-power cutoff.

tasks.title: Record the power budget
tasks.detail: Keep independent positive rails separate and verify all supply, cable and driver ratings.

tasks.title: Prepare the Pi operating system and SSH
tasks.detail: Select supported 64-bit Bookworm Desktop, create your login, enable SSH and connect from your computer.

groups.title: 2 · Assemble and wire with power off

tasks.title: Mount the base, four motors and wheels
tasks.detail: Secure fasteners, low-mounted supplies and insulated board supports.

tasks.title: Mount and balance the pan/tilt head
tasks.detail: Verify unpowered retention and cable clearance; mark the manual centre.

tasks.title: Place and label all sensors
tasks.detail: Label the different ToF and cliff orders, fix the IMU to the base and check floor clearance.

tasks.title: Wire the Pi, display and storage
tasks.detail: Use the correct USB-C power, micro-HDMI, USB touch and storage ports.

tasks.title: Connect the Mega by USB
tasks.detail: Use a data-capable cable; leave motor power off and avoid positive-rail backfeeding.

tasks.title: Wire the left wheel driver and two motors
tasks.detail: Match the identified board interface, all seven signals, logic supply, motor supply and returns.

tasks.title: Wire the right wheel driver and two motors
tasks.detail: Use the separate right-side signal mapping; one motor per channel.

tasks.title: Wire the pan stepper and ULN2003
tasks.detail: Confirm the five-wire motor connector and IN1–IN4 order D30–D33.

tasks.title: Wire the tilt stepper and ULN2003
tasks.detail: Confirm the motor connector and IN1–IN4 order D34–D37; test without a falling load.

tasks.title: Wire all three distance sensors
tasks.detail: Shared SDA/SCL plus individual XSHUT; validate breakout voltage and pull-ups first.

tasks.title: Wire the tilt/IMU board
tasks.detail: Shared I2C, identified supply, AD0 address and a fixed base mounting.

tasks.title: Wire and label the three KY-033 cliff sensors
tasks.detail: Digital outputs to D39, D40 and D41 in front-left, rear-centre, front-right order.

tasks.title: Wire the presence sensor
tasks.detail: Identify actual pin labels, supply and output level; OUT goes to D38.

tasks.title: Wire both touch pads
tasks.detail: Use Pi-safe active-high momentary outputs on BCM27 and BCM22.

tasks.title: Connect the camera and its indicator
tasks.detail: Power off for CSI ribbon work; current-limit the visible activity LED.

tasks.title: Connect microphone, amplifier and speakers
tasks.detail: Choose the matching USB/analogue interface and check amplifier output isolation.

tasks.title: Connect direct-powered cooling
tasks.detail: Match fan voltage and connector polarity; keep fans off signal GPIO pins.

tasks.title: Pass the unpowered wiring inspection
tasks.detail: Check continuity, shorts, rail separation, connectors, current paths and cutoff before power-on.

tasks.title: M00 · Foundation
tasks.detail: Install dependencies, verify a fresh locked configuration and pass software self-tests.

tasks.title: M01 · Face on the display
tasks.detail: Verify the real Pi desktop, fullscreen kiosk and changing expressions.

tasks.title: M02 · Mega link and firmware
tasks.detail: Flash the correct device, verify fingerprint and test USB disconnect/reconnect.

tasks.title: M03 · Measured power
tasks.detail: Verify both rails, loaded supply flags, switch function and motor/driver current ratings.

tasks.title: M04 · Distance, tilt and cliff calibration
tasks.detail: Verify all three ranges, tilt, fresh telemetry and individual floor/edge calibration.

tasks.title: M05 · Stop and fault behavior
tasks.detail: Prove obstacle, cliff, tilt, stale-link and emergency-stop behavior before enabling motion.

tasks.title: M06 · Cooling
tasks.detail: Measure temperature after a sustained face/runtime session.

tasks.title: M07 · Wheels
tasks.detail: Use lifted short tests first, prove automatic and emergency stops, then a contained floor test.

tasks.title: M08 · Pan/tilt head
tasks.detail: Establish manual home, measure travel and prove small jogs and stop behavior.

tasks.title: M09 · Touch pads
tasks.detail: Verify head response, back tap and one-second back hold emergency stop.

tasks.title: M10 · Local camera
tasks.detail: Verify Picamera2, activity LED, local eye following and separately gated head tracking.

tasks.title: M11 · Local notes
tasks.detail: Save, list, persist through restart and erase an explicit note.

tasks.title: M12 · Local dialogue
tasks.detail: Test English, Hindi and Marathi commands; keep optional model/cloud settings deliberate.

tasks.title: M13 · Voice input and output
tasks.detail: Identify ALSA devices, test all speech languages, calibrate mic and verify half-duplex behavior.

tasks.title: M14 · Companion behavior
tasks.detail: Verify presence greeting, cooldown, night hours, sleepy face and wake behavior.

tasks.title: M15 · Reminders
tasks.detail: Set a short reminder, restart and verify one delivery at the correct time.

tasks.title: M16 · Sleep and control access
tasks.detail: Verify sleep/wake and authorized control access using the intended local/tunnel route.

tasks.title: M17 · Whole robot and startup
tasks.detail: Complete attended acceptance, prove no automatic motion on restart and test autostart.

tasks.title: Practice the daily start and stop procedure
tasks.detail: Start with motor power off, inspect status, begin an attended session and shut down cleanly.

tasks.title: Back up the Pi configuration and local data
tasks.detail: Keep private calibration, notes and stage records out of the public repository.

tasks.title: Keep an offline copy of the full guide
tasks.detail: Download the generated documentation artifact, extract it and verify local navigation.

tasks.title: Export this progress notebook
tasks.detail: Keep the downloaded JSON with your build records so you can restore on another device.
